semanticCorrections.decision: 暮らして is the inflected verb暮らす, not the noun暮らし; original Japanese/Chinese preserved.
お知らせします reuses知らせる through the honorificおVします construction, not the noun知らせ.
申し込み explicitly reuses the taught申込 target after checking entry1605140; no new root.
Narrative描く uses source-restrictedえがく; new independent contextual sense, not the painting sense withかく.
Experiencing a work uses the new触れる sense, not physical contact.
Evaluation high uses a separate高い sense from physical height/price.
Exchanging information is taught separately from replacing physical parts or swapping books.
Reaching a conclusion and a pronoun referring to a person have their own contextual targets; neither borrows quantity-reaching or physical-pointing mastery.

sensePolicy: The six targets are independent teaching scopes of existing roots. Some use different senses of the dictionary, while broader dictionary senses such as交換/達する are narrowed operationally; no claim that all six are separate dictionary lexemes or new word roots.

morphologyPolicy.decision: Compose known numerals/counters and quantity grammar; do not create a new root for each number.
Known卒業/章 with time/frequency suffixes; no combinatorial roots.
Explicitly teach the respective的 suffix and数+period prefix inG006, with checked source facts; no new root.
手続 reuses手続き;締切 reuses締め切り;表題/標題 is one source entry;具体 does not duplicate the already taught具体的. Candidates excluded, not new words.
